bundle_argument.meaning: Authorized filesystem envelope containing the manifest and every relative model/cache target.
bundle_argument.path_resolution: model/cache paths are resolved relative to mixed_precision_manifest.json, then checked to remain under --bundle
bundle_argument.cache_requirement: all 25 cache and cache_identity fields must be non-null before any K100 evaluator starts

required_operational_gates: 25 ONNX models pass checker and static FP32 boundary contracts
CPU sequential candidate output is finite
25 MIGraphX profiles contain positive MIGraphX events and zero CPU events
all intersegment outputs remain device OrtValues

same_protocol_fp32_summary.formal_speedup: matching-scope FP32 median-of-three-trial-medians divided by candidate median-of-three-trial-medians

container_and_runtime_lock.container_image: full sha256 image ID is verified by docker inspect and passed to every trial
container_and_runtime_lock.runtime_fingerprint: one deterministic DTK/MIGraphX/ORT fingerprint is generated in the locked image and identity-checked by every trial
container_and_runtime_lock.process_provenance: every result records Python PID plus timezone-qualified started_at and ended_at

scopes.model_only: fixed device input/intermediates/output; 25 Python ORT dispatches; excludes H2D, D2H, and session load
scopes.end_to_end_logits: host float32 tensor through H2D and 25 resident sessions to D2H float32 logits; excludes file I/O, preprocessing, and session load

performance.output_validation: only inference 30 of warmup and inference 100 of measurement are copied for validation; no extra inference is inserted between or after timed loops

k100_vram.separation: one fresh process per candidate after all timed trials; its sampler is never active during latency measurement
k100_vram.scope: device-wide mem_info_vram_used from a pre-session baseline through 25 resident sessions, fixed OrtValues, and 30 warmups plus 100 untimed exercises for each of model-only and end-to-end-logits
k100_vram.same_protocol_fp32: measure_phase11_k100_vram_around_command.py wraps one disposable run of the frozen FP32 25-segment benchmark; every latency artifact from that wrapped run is invalid and only VRAM is retained
k100_vram.limitation: the sysfs counter is device-wide rather than per-process, so the launcher must establish an idle K100 before each run

capacity_and_pareto.capacity: sum all 25 manifest-locked ONNX and MXR payload sizes; runtime/container/filesystem allocation excluded
capacity_and_pareto.selection_boundary: only candidates whose trial-median CV is at most 5 percent are Pareto-eligible; the selected mixed candidate advances to kernel/deployment validation but does not replace FP16 full at this stage
